review.dependency_review: Neither original depends on missing commercial access or authentic bank data. A blocked original must not block its independent partner or another ready operation.
review.evidence_review: Discovery metadata identifies candidates only. A title, abstract, or unversioned latest download cannot establish a technical claim or cutoff eligibility.
review.causal_review: Subpopulation response agreement and question-answer accuracy cannot by themselves identify an intervention effect. Distinguish synthetic response distributions from actual customer outcomes.
review.acceptance_review: The 113-candidate denominator, broader search obligations, Q1/Q5 and rendered visual acceptance remain open unless their separate criteria are met.
review.execution_review: Short commands and durable evidence. No subagents, remote code execution, sibling changes, bank experiments, or images in this inherited session.
